name: Work selection facts: next-action actor, reconciliation state and bounded claimability
summary: One bounded selection projection beside the review state, computed once so `work`, the brief's `review` block and `review TASK` cannot disagree. next_actor is the next-action actor as a caller-neutral ROLE from the SAME decision that gives whose_move: whose_move is the caller-relative answer, next_actor that decision's role, and both read unknown where the decision cannot be told (integrated work; a withdrawn or superseded final revision with no open item). Never null; a malformed row reads operator. work_state is the review state shown, or reconciliation-needed when recorded lifecycle evidence and the current contribution disagree; reconciliation_needed/reconciliation_reasons name the mismatch (integration facts disagreeing, or a newest scope naming a PRIOR revision while the current one has no pass). It replaces no review_state, clears no blocker, infers no deployment. claimable is one bounded rule (open, unassigned, no contribution, not an epic, decision, gate, job, record anchor or a task labelled decision); `work --claimable` offers exactly those rows, never a reservation. `--state` filters on the state shown, plus reconciliation-needed.
